name: Bureau
direction: See the whole. Focus on one. Decide.

brand.name: Agentic Bureau (official: licence, terms, website, store listings, social); Bureau (the app, CLI, docs, window and conversation)
brand.geometry: Two rows of a checker: 10 squares on a 5 × 5 grid at a 20-unit pitch (the favicon on a 16 grid)
brand.colours: Signal cyan #4FC8F0 and ice #C6F1FF on the #0A0E12 tile; the light mark keeps the cyan and turns ice to ink
brand.provenance: Supplied by the product owner as vector artwork
brand.usage: Two-tone in the renderer (var(--signal) and var(--ice)); one-colour exports for print and single-ink use

icons.note: Drawn for Bureau; names follow the Phosphor names they replace so call sites read the same

libraries.role: Kit Menu and the project menu
Kit Tooltip and icon button names
STL viewport and illustrative preview geometry

preview.data: Disposable rover and drone projects created through CoreApp
preview.meshStatus: Illustrative only; not a verified OpenSCAD render or manufacturing model
preview.agentExecution: Disabled in browser preview; the desktop app runs the real adapter

rasterAssets: Captured application screenshots and the brand PNG exports only
retired: Omen Flow name and the two-arc mark
Geist and IBM Plex Mono in the interface, Phosphor icons
The icon activity bar and the separate title bar
Overview dashboard, inspector side panel, status bar
Michroma lettering, aircraft artwork, ASCII aircraft
legacyCompatibility: .omenflow project storage and omenflow.project.json, renamed to .bureau and bureau.project.json when a project is opened
Omen Flow settings folders, carried over on first launch
omenflow:guide blocks in a project AGENTS.md, taken over by the Bureau guide
omenflow-* format and provenance identifiers (archives, snapshots, build packages, STEP and mesh checks), kept as written

catalogue.method: Real components rendered in Dark and Light side by side; contrast measured from the tokens in force

accessibility.contrast: Text, supporting and metadata text and state words meet WCAG AA (4.5:1) on every surface in both themes; signal strokes, focus rings and separators meet 3:1

screenshots: screenshots/ holds captures of the Omen Flow interface, kept as history

filmFonts.note: Kept for the launch film and trailer until they are re-cut
